attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Changing the DI registration order of the workflow content handler alters its execution order relative to all other IContentHandler implementations for every content event across every tenant/module, which could subtly break other extensions that relied on the previous ordering even though this fix is well-intentioned."}
